parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries no structural evidence whatsoever: differing_slots, jaccard, shared_ancestor, and shared_field_count are all null, and the members array is empty. Without any grounded field-level or shape-level data comparing PlaybackButtonControls and LCDBrightnessControls, there is no basis on which to recommend a refactor. The two types reside in the same DebugUI/ThemeDebugOverlay directory of the Wallpaper package and share a line-15 declaration offset, but that alone is coincidental structural alignment rather than evidence of meaningful duplication or a subset relationship.
